An '''artifact''' created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]] was one of a set of five [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] that he used to [[Conquest of the Dromund system|conquer]] the [[Dromund system]]. The artifact was recovered around [[3643 BBY]] by the group of pirates of the ''[[Sky Princess]]''. It began affecting the crew and first mate [[Sylas Wilkes]] led a mutiny against the captain [[Andronikos Revel]], ejecting him in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Eventually Wilkes joined up with the [[Exchange]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and Andronikos, who did time in an Imperial prison, allowing [[Darth Zash]] to learn about the artifact, followed him to the planet. Wilkes sent out fifteen of his men with the artifact and a shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] for their boss, but the artifact drove the group mad, and they fled into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. As the artifact's influence over them grew, they were picked off one by one by either the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] or themselves. The last survivor [[Paal]] decided to bring the artifact to a Sand People campsite as a peace offering, but was killed as soon as he got there. The [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] of [[Darth Zash]] recovered the artifact from his body, and Zash later combined it with four other artifacts to perform the [[essence transfer]] ritual in the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tulak Hord's artifact on Tatooine appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission.
